title: Categories with more than three products
statementMd:
Which categories contain more than three products?

Expected columns: `category`, `products`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
